integrity: Theorems and transition proof are explicit; verifier enumerates full finite ideal lattices and is not offered as proof for unbounded n; prior period results and known total-count sequences are acknowledged.
limitations: Classical ideal-rowmotion only on vertex-edge incidence posets of stars with at least two arms. Proof valid for all \(n\ge2\); direct finite replay \(1\le n\le8\). Exact orbit multiplicity novelty is best-knowledge with residual risk of unindexed computations, not independently assessed.
title: Complete rowmotion cycle profile for star-incidence posets
